s07_f00e: Good evening, General.
Your performance has been outstanding, as always.
However, I have some bad news.
Vladimir, before this news becomes public,
it is best that you hear it first.
Premier Romanov is ill,
and can no longer carry out his duties.
Really?
But that is not our greatest concern.
The Allies have turned to the German professor, Albert Einstein.
He has built them a Chronosphere,
a device capable of transporting large forces.
My sources have identified their first target:
our research laboratory in the Ural Mountains.
I believe the Allies intend to steal our Apocalypse tank plans.
Oh? Your sources did not warn you that Einstein was involved?
Or is he beyond your cheap mind-control tricks?
That is enough.
You traitor!
You fool! Do not think I will let you take whatever you want!
Enough! General Vladimir,
my tanks and my soldiers are knocking at your door...
Concern yourself with your dismissal. Your days are numbered.
General? Do your best to defend the Urals. I will convey your concern for the Premier.
s07_p01e: There is something you should know.
General Carville has deployed a truck in our villages.
trying to stir our people into rebellion.
s07_p02e: I think we should send a few attack dogs
